expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Adds or replaces the value associated with Key. Removes Key and copies its previous value when found. @param OutValue Receives the removed value on success. Removes Key and reports whether an entry existed. Removes every entry and reserves optional capacity. @param Slack Desired post-clear allocation capacity. Removes every entry while retaining reusable allocation. Removes the current entry; iterator-debug builds enforce mutation safety. Replaces the current value.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void TMap<K,V>.Add(const K& Key, const V& Value); | bool TMap<K,V>.RemoveAndCopyValue(const K& Key, V& OutValue); | bool TMap<K,V>.Remove(const K& Key); | void TMap<K,V>.Empty(int32 Slack = 0); | void TMap<K,V>.Reset(); | void TMapIterator<K,V>.RemoveCurrent() const; | void TMapIterator<K,V>.SetValue(const V& NewValue) const;
